topics.label: Introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the opening framing for the lecture, outlining the learning outcomes and introducing the framework of the hallmarks of cancer.

topics.label: Deregulated growth signaling and pathway mutations
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how mutations in key signaling cascades, such as the Wnt/beta-catenin and receptor tyrosine kinase pathways, drive growth factor independence and sustained cell proliferation.

topics.label: Blocks to terminal differentiation in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how differentiation blocks prevent cells from reaching functional maturity and exiting the cell cycle in hematopoietic malignancies and colorectal carcinoma.

topics.label: Resistance to apoptosis, replicative immortality, and p53 regulation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how cancer cells circumvent programmed cell death, bypass replicative senescence via telomerase activation, and overcome p53-mediated genome protection.

topics.label: Complex hallmarks and metabolic rewiring in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics introduce complex cancer hallmarks and explain how cancer cells rewire their metabolism through aerobic glycolysis, Krebs cycle enzyme mutations, and oncometabolite production.

topics.label: Tumor angiogenesis and the angiogenic switch
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explores how developing tumors stimulate new blood vessel growth to overcome diffusion limits for oxygen and nutrients.

topics.label: Mechanisms, detection, and genomics of tumor metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the metastatic cascade, barriers to tumor dissemination, liquid biopsy monitoring using circulating tumor cells, and the genomic characteristics of metastatic clones.

topics.label: Summary and concluding remarks
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the closing framing for the lecture, summarizing the convergence of cancer hallmarks and offering concluding remarks and recommended reading.
